ICS 97.140CED 351. ScopeThis standard (Part 2) prescribes the requirements for the following items of steel furniture and fittings meant for use in a library:a) Book racks,b) Book trolley,c) Book ends,d) Catalogue cards tray,e) Card index cabinets,f) Catalogue cards work tray,g) Charging trays,h) Reading-room table,j) Study table,k) Chairs,m) Book cases, andn) Glass-front cabinets.2. REFERENCESThe standards given in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated at Annex A.
